newsitem.title: GERMANY: Last in, first out for Lufthansa investors.
newsitem.headline: Last in, first out for Lufthansa investors.

text.p: Germany's Transport Ministry said on Tuesday any enforced share sales according to a new draft law limiting foreign ownership of airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG were not likely to affect existing shareholders.
"We will be working under the principle of 'last in, first out'," ministry spokesman Franz-Josef Schneiders told a news conference.

The new law would allow compulsory repurchase of shares if foreign investors held more than 50 percent of shares in the airline, something that would bring it into conflict with international air law.
Lufthansa currently has a foreign shareholder base of around 20 percent. The Bonn government is due to sell its remaining 36 percent stake in the airline towards the end of this year.
